_comment: Allow-list for scripts/check_ui_copy_forbidden_phrases.py (ST-07, BLG-FE-183). Each entry suppresses ONE literal in ONE file, keyed on its exact text, and must carry a justification (>= 20 characters). A stale entry (matching no literal) fails the lint. See the script's docstring.

entries.literal: Why enter now? What specific trigger confirms the thesis?
entries.justification: Placeholder text for the Entry Rationale field: it asks the user a reflective question about their own reasoning and is not an instruction or recommendation to enter a trade. It matches the 'enter now' pattern lexically only.

entries.literal: Describes your recorded figures only. Not a forecast, recommendation or tax advice.
entries.justification: The AI summary's advisory caption (ST-25, EPIC-04, v9.11): it uses 'forecast' only to disclaim one. Required verbatim by §13 Condition 6 of decisions--2026-10-08__release-v9.11--ST-25-monthly-pnl-narrative-section13-review.md and approved by the Product Owner in the design record.
